title: Prop Firm Registry Entry
description: Lightweight identity record for a prop firm, kept separate from its rule records (firm-account-rules.schema.json) so a rebrand, URL change, or status change never requires touching historical rule data. Rule records reference these by 'firm_id'.

firm_id.description: Stable slug used as the join key from firm-account-rules records, e.g. 'apex', 'take-profit-trader', 'tradeify'. Treat as immutable once any rule record references it — rename by migration, never in place.

display_name.description: Firm's current public-facing name, e.g. 'Apex Trader Funding'.

legal_name.description: Registered legal entity name if it differs from the brand name (useful for verifying source documents and payout-entity questions).

rules_url.description: Best single landing page for the firm's rulebook/FAQ — the default 'view source' link in the UI when a more specific source_url isn't shown inline.

platform_notes.description: Which trading platforms/data feeds the firm supports (e.g. Tradovate, Rithmic, NinjaTrader) — informs which accounts this product can eventually pull live state from via adapters.

status.description: Whether the firm is currently a going concern worth tracking. 'defunct' firms are kept (not deleted) for historical/comparison value but should be visually de-emphasized and excluded from default comparison views.

notes.description: Anything a researcher updating this firm's rule records should know up front (e.g. 'frequently changes drawdown amounts without dating the change on their site — cross-check via support chat transcripts').
